messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":7,"verses":[{"chapter":7,"verse":16,"text":"And when they saw me shake my head they threw themselves down upon the ground, all overcome with emotion"},{"chapter":7,"verse":17,"text":"And while their hosts were standing around, I saw the three kings lie upon the ground for three hours like dead."},{"chapter":7,"verse":18,"text":"Then they rose and said to each other: We cannot believe that this is Jobab\"."},{"chapter":7,"verse":19,"text":"And finally, after they had for seven days inquired after everything concerning me and searched for my flocks and other possessions, they said:"},{"chapter":7,"verse":20,"text":"\"Do we not know how many goods were sent by him to the cities and the villages round about to be given to the poor, aside from all that was given away by him within his own house How then could he have fallen into such a state of perdition and misery !\""}],"book_code":"TJOB"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 16,17,18,19,20 in this chapter.
